basic_profile.bio: Avid DIY enthusiast and casual 3D printing hobbyist based in Fairfield County, CT. I dabble in various interests, including entomophagy and cryptocurrency betting. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to explore my creative side. I enjoy watching animated series and Japanese comedy shows in my downtime. Usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently in a long-term relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained practical experience in 3D printing through self-teaching and online tutorials. My interest in entomophagy was sparked by a college course on sustainable food sources. Cryptocurrency betting is a recent venture, fueled by curiosity and discussions with friends.
